camera: Flat front-facing 2D UI over a strictly top-down painted terrain map; no perspective.

spatialRatios.characterScreenHeight: no characters; main focal unit is the terrain map strip, 1/4 of screen height
spatialRatios.renderingTechnique: flat-graphic top-down painted terrain map framed by programmatic 9-slice UI chrome

hudLayout.topThird: 0-8%: stone-grey header slab: tilted brown chapter book top-left with gold '1' and 'CHAPTER'; three charcoal counter slots: gold hex coin '0', green star '0', pink meeple '33'; below them a 4-segment dark quest bar with the first segment part-filled grey and gold '0/4' at right. 8-15%: dark walnut wood strip with one parchment quest scroll centred, red wax seal with yellow '!'. 16-19%: khaki tab bar: left small tab with farm cottage icon and red badge '4'; wide selected tab with grey stone ruin icon and white bold 'DESERT RUIN'; three dark grey locked tabs with black silhouettes. 19-33%: top-down terrain map begins.
hudLayout.middleThird: 19-44%: terrain map: sandy dune/pyramid top-left, a teal river with golden sandy banks winding left to right, dense dark conifer clusters on olive ground, a small grey stone keep on the left, patchwork farm fields bottom-left, a thin dirt road. 44-94%: a large empty dark navy gradient field (placeholder, no content).
hudLayout.bottomThird: Empty dark navy field continues to 94%. 94-100%: dark walnut wood footer bar with debug text 'fps: 60.02' bottom-left, 'username' centre, and a steel-blue cog settings button bottom-right.

playspaceType: region map with empty dungeon list
keyElements: quest scroll centred on wood strip
location tab bar with DESERT RUIN selected
uiStyle: Chunky stone-grey and khaki 9-slice slabs with dark lips, charcoal counter wells, crisp clean edges, white bold sans labels; flat-graphic terrain map with crisp cut-paper shapes.

lighting.shadowCharacter: soft gradient falloff; hard offset drop shadows under slabs
lighting.highlightType: soft glossy highlights on coin, star, scroll
lighting.ambient: neutral; big area falls to cool navy dark

colorPalette: Warm grey/khaki/walnut chrome at top and bottom, olive-teal-ochre map, then a cold dark navy void for half the screen.
mood: Quiet, freshly-unlocked region waiting to be explored.
composition: Top-heavy: dense header and map in the top 44%, then empty space, then a thin footer.

content.map: dune/pyramid, teal river, conifers, stone keep left, farm fields
